Slot history sysvar init, update, read, and slot lookup logic.

# Purpose
This C file implements the `slot_history` sysvar logic used by the bank and account database code. It defines the in-memory layout and size rules for the slot history account, then provides functions to create, update, write, and read that account. The main data structure is `fd_slot_history_global_t`, which stores the next slot value and a bit vector that marks which recent slots are present in history.

The file also provides slot lookup logic through [`fd_sysvar_slot_history_find_slot`](<#fd_sysvar_slot_history_find_slot>), which classifies a slot as future, too old, found, or not found. The [`fd_sysvar_slot_history_set`](<#fd_sysvar_slot_history_set>) helper updates the bit vector when the bank advances to a new slot, and the init and update functions encode the structure back into the sysvar account with `fd_sysvar_account_update`. This code is part of the sysvar implementation layer and is intended to be used by other runtime components that manage bank state and transaction execution.
